mission: Reusable continuity rulebook for the WHOLE F11 feature (established by the opening; applied to every later scene).
basedOn: artistic-bible-f10-v1.json (carried where compatible) + F11 direction + character-registry-f11.json

visual.look: photorealistic cinematic live-action, 35mm, naturalistic motivated lighting, real fabrics/materials, filmic colour
visual.palette: cold Norse steel-grey ∩ Egyptian sun-ochre; the SEAM = gold-light signature
visual.styleRoute: mediaCategory → model (STILL_ANIMATABLE→flux-dev, PREMIUM_VIDEO→seedance-2.5/veo-3-fast); photoreal anchor on every prompt; anachronism scan before gen
negativeConstraints: no city/architecture in open-sea scenes (SC01 lesson)

twoSunSky.rule: ONE locked two-sun sky plate reused from B3 onward (Act I shore through Act III); single sun only in the pre-crossing storm (B1) and the final SC47 restoration

character.ids: character-registry-f11.json CHAR-### are immutable; costume/injury/age are continuity STATES not new identities

BJÖRN (CHAR-013).look: massive muscular Viking; greatsword Himinkljúfr on back
BJÖRN (CHAR-013).weapon: Himinkljúfr tracked every shot (slung / planted / set-down at the climax)

ASTRID (CHAR-001).look: Norse seafarer garb, salt-stained; star-chart forearm tattoo (CANON — never flagged as anachronism)

OLAF (CHAR-008).look: grey, failing; heavy wool cloak; bronze arm-ring
OLAF (CHAR-008).state: declining across the opening; arm-ring passes to Björn later

character.regendered: IPY→IPU (boy, water-jug), WIDOW→WIDOWER (old man) — minor, group-coherence only

costumeProps.MERYT: river-guard harness; right-forearm wound bound in Norse cloth (CANON)

weaponContinuity.rule: every weapon tracked shot-to-shot; no disappearing/teleporting blades; Himinkljúfr is the hero prop with a payoff (planted at the seam, then in the cairn)

lightingWeather.B3-B7: two-sun daylight/ochre; the bleed tints edges uncanny
lightingWeather.rule: weather/light state continuous within a beat; document any deliberate change at a cut

geography.rule: readable spatial continuity; establish then hold screen direction across a cut; the seam-root is the fixed Act-III stage
geography.openingGeo: storm sea → impossible shore → river-town strand

sound.identity: the sea and the seam are sonic characters (seam = signature hum); environmental sound carries dread
sound.mix: music/sfx/VO layered in edit; silent generation shots judged visual-only

editRaccord.rule: crossfade/J-L cuts at ambience-change boundaries (sound-raccord doctrine); relief beats between set-pieces; no two mass-VFX shots back-to-back

applicability: These rules are the feature's continuity contract. Every later milestone must conform or record an explicit, documented deviation.
